thread:
maya (PM): quick sync: post-launch were getting a handful of Dedicated tenant reports about slow embedding responses. want to pick short-term mitigation vs longer roadmap. cc @aj @tom

aj (Eng Lead): checking logs. preliminary repro in staging: p95 jumps when batch_size >= 12. likely batching + kv-cache pressure.

tom (SRE): logs show timeouts: `ERROR embed-svc req=aa11 timeout=88s batch=16`. recommend avoiding full revert.

lee (Customer Success): tenant-Delta flagged SLA alerts. theyd like an ETA for a fix. temporary cap would be acceptable.

rachel (Design): customers also asked about recall improvements in search  enhancement request; capture for roadmap.

maya (PM): options: 1) revert (risky) 2) per-tenant soft cap (fast) 3) epic for robustness (days). propose 2 + create epic.

aj (Eng Lead): I can add a per-tenant default cap behind a feature flag. ETA ~60m for PR + CI.

tom (SRE): I'll wire infra flag rollout and add tenant-level p95 alerts.

lee (Customer Success): Delta will accept the cap if ETA < 2h. please confirm timeline so I can message them.

aj (Eng Lead): PR: https://github.com/redwood/embed-service/pull/601 (adds per-tenant cap). requesting review.

tom (SRE): staging QA: batch=16 -> 90s, batch=8 -> 22s. cap=8 looks safe. approving.

maya (PM): plan: merge + canary to Dedicated us-west by EOD, monitor 15m, then roll. create epic RDW-290 "Embeddings robustness" for tuning (kv-cache, quant). owners: aj (eng), tom (sre), maya (pm), rachel (comm).

lee (Customer Success): will update Delta once canary goes live. thanks team.

aj (Eng Lead): merged and started canary at 1754443320.

tom (SRE): canary healthy at +10m. p95 normalized for sample tenants.

maya (PM): closing: short-term cap in place until robustness work ships. will put RDW-290 on next grooming.
